title: Recover transactionally from failed imports
description: Harden import validation and commit rollback so malformed bundles, resource limits, migration failures, conflicts, and injected transaction failures preserve existing workspace state and produce actionable reports.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema, integrity, reference, resource, migration, and conflict failures are reported before mutation
Injected commit failures roll back every imported record, asset, index, and relationship
Post-failure canonical records and exact asset bytes equal the pre-import workspace
Reports identify stage, affected entries, reason codes, and safe corrective actions without exposing private content unnecessarily
Retry, cancel, and report review remain keyboard operable offline

steps.details: Confirm parse, bounds, schema, integrity, reference, migration, conflict-plan, commit, and verification stages have explicit no-mutation boundaries.
Commit the accepted plan through the established transaction boundary and roll back records, assets, indexes, and relationships on any failure.
Return bounded stage-specific entries, reason codes, affected identities, and retry/correction guidance.
Inject each validation/commit failure and compare canonical pre/post records, relationships, asset bytes, and durable markers.
Exercise report review, cancellation, retry, announcements, and focus restoration with network blocked.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; reuse tiny hostile fixtures and focused rollback checkpoints.
Validation must finish before the first workspace mutation.
